# Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Bing Crosby, The Marx Brothers, Mildred Bailey with Teddy Wilson, and Hercule Poirot

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Bing Crosby, Ford Road Show, Marx Brothers, Groucho Marx, Chico Marx, Mildred Bailey, Teddy Wilson, Hercule Poirot, Agatha Christie, Charles Laughton, Heartbeats in Sports Headlines, Gabby Street, Ben Bernie, Against The Storm, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 88 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 88 recovers and dates 15 historical broadcasts spanning 1950s network drive-time radio, legendary Broadway comedy royalty, golden age jazz collaborations, Belgian detective mysteries, master dramatic readings, daytime serial milestones, and sports history legends: 3 autumn 1957 broadcasts from Bing Crosby on ***The Ford Road Show*** (CBS), Groucho and Chico Marx starring in a hilarious 1944 Hollywood agents parody sketch on ***Hollywood Agents***, Mildred Bailey singing 'More Than You Know' backed by jazz pianist Teddy Wilson (CBS, 1944), Harold Huber solving 'The Case of the Roving Corpse' on ***Agatha Christie's Hercule Poirot*** (Mutual, 1945), Charles Laughton reading Dickens' *Mr. Pickwick's Christmas* (Christmas Eve 1944), 2 baseball history dispatches on Mort Nussbaum's ***Heartbeats in Sports Headlines*** detailing catcher Gabby Street's 1908 Washington Monument baseball catch and Cardinals pennants, 'The Old Maestro' Ben Bernie live from the Hotel Roosevelt (1933), Peabody Award winner ***Against the Storm*** (1941), Paramount Pictures' musical preview for *Bring on the Girls* (1945), and Gordon MacRae leading the 1949 National Christmas Seal campaign.
